testResults.name: focused-mcp-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/mcp tests/harness/cli/test_commands.py
testResults.result: 38 tests (22 new): initialize handshake, exact default tool set (trader absent unless the capability flag is set; shadow/live have no field at all and never appear), remote-API contract mirror with bearer header and payload shape, exact local argv for backtest/sweep/trader, get_* payload mapping, malformed JSON-RPC and unknown-method error objects, stdio framing with graceful EOF shutdown, no-credential serialization; 16 CLI regression tests green

testResults.name: protocol-and-auth
testResults.result: Newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio (MCP stdio convention), diagnostics to stderr only, error codes -32700/-32600/-32601/-32602/-32603, isError results for domain failures; bearer from HARNESS_API_BEARER_TOKEN via injected source, serialized settings carry only the env-var name and a bearer_configured boolean

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2408 passed, 14 skipped, 1 xfailed at wave edit freeze

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/harness/mcp tests/harness/mcp src/harness/cli/__init__.py && uv run --extra dev ty check src/harness/mcp

limitations: No new dependencies: the MCP stdio framing is implemented by hand (JSON-RPC 2.0), so protocol-version negotiation is fixed at 2024-11-05 with tools/listChanged false
